text.tspan: FRAME — Curt inks connecting lines across the sketch from panel 2 — a
web, every agent lane joined to every other. ChatGPT's block returns beside
it with the source passage open, one sentence held up against the drawing.
SCREEN / SYSTEM TEXT — CHATGPT — “The record has no line
between two runs. Each one writes into the cache and reads what is already
there. Draw the web and you have drawn a network nobody found.”
ACTION — Curt erases every connecting line. The lanes end up touching
the directory tree and nothing else — the geometry pages 001–005 already
DIALOGUE — CURT — “That's the first thing I had wrong. And I'd have
drawn it a hundred more times.”
